name: 35228 · Birmingham, AL
findings: ZIP 35228 (Birmingham) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 3 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 35228 (Birmingham) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
